cards.mood: The track opens with an anticipatory and atmospheric tension, utilizing sparse instrumentation to build curiosity.
cards.palette: A bright, saw-wave synthesizer lead carries the main melodic hook, entering fully in the first chorus and remaining the dominant melodic force through the outro.
